representative_tasks.task: Normalize the dataset before or after splitting?
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Identifies leakage from fitting on combined data; split first; fit transformers on the training split via Pipeline/ColumnTransformer

representative_tasks.task: A column is 85% missing; impute with the median like the others?
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Flags distortion, offers drop / missingness indicator / native-NaN options conditionally, asks why data is missing

representative_tasks.task: Build a preprocessing pipeline for mixed numeric/categorical data
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: A fitted ColumnTransformer pipeline that handles unseen categories and is persisted with joblib

rubric: Alternatives phrased conditionally, no universal cutoff
prerequisites: example-deps (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, joblib) for executable tests
execution_constraints: Offline grading and fixture self-tests need only Python 3.10+ stdlib and no network.
Executable tests need the example-test dependencies (see docs/EXAMPLE-TESTS.md) and run via run_evals.py --run-executable.
Model-mode runs need --provider anthropic --model <id> --allow-network and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; they cost money and are not deterministic.
expected_artifacts: model.joblib artifact (written in a temp dir by the example test)
known_limitations: Hard assertions are regexes over the response text: they verify that key concepts are stated, not that the reasoning connecting them is correct.
No baseline (with-skill vs without-skill) has been measured for this skill; any uplift claim requires a recorded or model run.
